audit.why: 52.38% over 42 games. He owns level 1, you own 3-6 on range, he reclaims it as a two-item drain tank. The entry says that.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1] and phases[3] tell you to trade 'when Trundle's Subjugate is down' at level 2 and levels 4-5. He does not have it until 6. phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds'.
audit.why: An ultimate cannot be the level-2 gate. The real early gate is Pillar of Ice (E, 21s at rank 1 down to 15s, 1000 range) — it is the only thing in his kit that can stop you leaving, and at 21 seconds it is the longest punish window he owns.
audit.corrected: Both phase lines re-keyed to Pillar of Ice with the real number; ultimate name fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings call his E 'Pillar of Filth'. It is Pillar of Ice. Chomp's auto-reset and King's Tribute are both missing.
audit.why: The packet flagged the name directly. Beyond that: Chomp is a 3.5-second auto-attack RESET, so his burst opens with an animation you can see rather than a cast — the wind-up is the cue to step back. King's Tribute heals him off a percent of the max health of any unit dying near him, so he is topped up by his own wave whether or not you poke him, and Subjugate steals health, armour and magic resist outright, doubling over four seconds. That combination is why armour and MR are the wrong purchase and why Grievous Wounds is not optional.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt on Pillar of Ice and Chomp with real numbers; the King's Tribute wave heal and the Subjugate stat theft stated.
